workItem: Expose the current package.json version, the Pull Request deployed in Render Production, and remaining Pull Request merges until the next automatic deploy at the top of every rendered PR body.
workItemDE: PR-Vorlage oben um package.json-Version, Render-Production-PR und verbleibende Auto-Deploy-Merges ergänzen
priorityReason: Die Merge-Entscheidung soll die produktive Render-PR und die verbleibende 5er-Deploy-Cadence ohne Navigation im PR-Kopf zeigen.
scopeBoundary: CAPITAL-AI-GOV / PVC-05 PR presentation and read-only cadence projection only.
The production PR number is derived from the immutable Production SHA by the existing merge-cadence resolver.
No new workflow, cadence controller, Render mutation, deployment trigger, version mutation, package.json edit or direct-main mutation.
exitEvidence: The first visible PR-body line shows current package.json version, Render Production PR and remaining PR merges until auto-deploy.
Render Production PR is deterministically parsed from the immutable production commit merge subject.
The existing 5/10 cadence resolver remains the single source of truth.
Unit and PR-body contract tests cover canonical merge subjects and header placement.
Hosted exact-head CI, Governance and Container Security pass.
acceptanceCriteria: All added placeholders are rendered by the existing PR renderer.
Current package version is read from package.json at the bound base ref.
Invalid or non-merge production SHAs render N/A instead of fabricating a PR number.
Human/CODEOWNER merge remains the protected final boundary.
releaseCondition: Release on Human/CODEOWNER merge, PR close, supersession or abandonment; no agent self-merge.
